questions.questionText: Which chamber of human heart pumps oxygenated blood to body via aorta?
questions.explanation: Left ventricle pumps oxygenated blood into systemic circulation via aorta.

questions.questionText: Functional unit of human kidney responsible for filtration is:
questions.explanation: Nephron is functional microscopic unit of kidney.

questions.questionText: Hormone responsible for lowering blood glucose level is:
questions.explanation: Pancreatic beta cells secrete Insulin to promote glucose uptake.

questions.questionText: Gas exchange in human lungs occurs across walls of:
questions.explanation: Alveoli provide massive surface area for diffusion of O2 and CO2.

questions.questionText: Vitamin essential for blood clotting is:
questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for prothrombin synthesis in liver.
